gmail.password: Google app password (blank = keep existing password)
gmail.explanation: Use a Google app password, not your regular password. Two-Step Verification is required. Organization policies or account protection may prevent app passwords. Changing your Google password may revoke them. No verification codes or OAuth are used. Saving here changes only this computer’s profile, not the task or Outlook calendar.
gmail.password_help: How do I get an app password?
gmail.secure_storage: Remembered secrets are stored in Windows Credential Manager, separate from application files and backups.
gmail.session_only: The password is available only for this session. It is not saved to disk; enter it again after restarting.
gmail.settings_saved: Email settings saved in this computer’s profile.
gmail.testing: Testing Gmail TLS and authentication… No message will be sent.
gmail.test_ok: TLS and authentication succeeded. No message was sent. This test does not guarantee message acceptance or delivery.
gmail.remove_confirm: Delete the local password and account metadata? Revoke the app password at Google separately in your Google account.
gmail.removed: Local credentials removed. To revoke the password, use your Google account.
gmail.compose_help: Gmail uses SMTP with TLS and the displayed account’s app password. It does not create drafts in Gmail web. An .eml file is local. The Outlook calendar is unchanged.
gmail.sending: Sending via Gmail… The form and attachments are retained until the result is known.
gmail.eml_saved: Local .eml saved with body and attachments. It is not a synced Gmail draft and was not sent.
gmail.eml_failed: The .eml file could not be saved. Check documents and destination; the form is retained.
gmail.result.accepted: Message accepted by Gmail’s server for sending from {account}. Delivery and reading are not confirmed.
gmail.result.partial: Message partially accepted by Gmail’s server from {account}. Do not resend to accepted recipients. Delivery is not confirmed.
gmail.result.rejected: Gmail’s server refused all recipients of the message from {account}. The form is retained.
gmail.result.uncertain: Uncertain SMTP result for {account}. The server may have accepted the message before disconnection. No automatic retry.
gmail.journal_failed: The SMTP result is known, but the local journal could not be written. Do not resend to repair the journal.
gmail.check_before_retry: Check Gmail and recipients before explicitly sending again. Switching providers does not unlock resending.
gmail.retry_confirm: Have you checked that the message was not already accepted/sent? Another attempt may create a duplicate. Unlock only by your explicit choice.
gmail.retry_ready: You can send again only through an explicit action and confirmation.
gmail.retry_refused_confirm: Remove accepted recipients from the form and keep refused recipients only? Nothing is sent until a new confirmation.
gmail.only_refused: The form contains refused recipients only. Check addresses and explicitly confirm if you want to send again.
gmail.error.account: Enter one valid Gmail/Google Workspace address without a name or alias. Custom domains are supported.
gmail.error.password: Enter your Google app password. Only presentation spaces are removed; control characters are not accepted.
gmail.error.not_configured: No Gmail password is available. Use Configure Gmail without closing the draft.
gmail.error.secure_unavailable: Secure storage is unavailable. You can enter the password for this session without saving it to disk.
gmail.error.profile_save: The email profile could not be saved. Previous settings remain active.
gmail.error.credential_reconcile: The profile was not saved and credentials could not be restored. Check Windows Credential Manager and configure the account again.
gmail.error.busy: A Gmail operation is in progress. Wait for its result before another operation.
gmail.error.auth: Gmail refused authentication. Check the address and app password; the password may be incorrect or revoked. Account policy or protection may block access.
gmail.error.auth_policy: Gmail requires an app password or an additional security condition. Check Two-Step Verification, account eligibility and organization policy. Do not enter your regular password.
gmail.error.network: Could not connect to Gmail. Check internet, DNS, proxy and firewall. The provider is not changed automatically.
gmail.error.timeout: The Gmail connection timed out before message submission. The operation was not retried.
gmail.error.tls: The secure TLS connection to Gmail could not be verified. Check system date and certificates. No unencrypted connection is attempted.
gmail.error.limit: Gmail imposed a limit or temporarily refused the operation. Check account limits; no automatic retry.
gmail.error.message: Gmail did not accept the operation. Check recipients, message size and account rules. The form is retained.
gmail.error.attachment: An attachment cannot be read. No incomplete message was sent. Check the selected documents.
gmail.error.uncertain: The SMTP response was lost after submission began. The message may already be accepted; the result is uncertain.
gmail.pending_removal: A previously stored credential could not be removed. Retry Remove credentials when secure storage is available.
